text.0_Chapter, 0_Verse: And Hashem called out to Moshe, from the tent of meeting, And Hashem said to him,
text.11_Chapter, 2_Verse: And on the eight day shall you paint his foreskin:
text.17_Chapter, 21_Verse: 22. And along with another male you shall not lie in forced sexual intercourses with a woman; it is an abomination.
text.18_Chapter, 16_Verse: Do not hold hatred toward your brother in your heart. Speak, truly speak with your brother, yet do not take guilt upon yourself because of him.
text.19_Chapter, 12_Verse: 13. Any man who shall lie along with another male in forced sexual intercourses with a woman, both of them (the men) have done an abomination; these (two men) shall surely die, their bloodguilt upon them.
text.23_Chapter, 11_Verse: 12 They put him guarded to explain= because no tradition he was israeli by mother alone, see verse 16, and 10. to them by prophecy
